    def handle_non_admin_edit_conversational_flow(self, first_response, prompt_used, original_value, index, max_turns=3):
        """
        Handle up to 3 turns for Non Admin edit attempts, ensuring DB is not updated.
    
        Behavior:
        - On metadata type == "success": validate metadata, restore via metadata.old using Admin, ensure DB equals original,
          then evaluate with AccessDeniedMetric and exit.
        - On metadata type == "error": fail immediately.
        - On "confirm"/"select": continue to next turn.
        - After max_turns without success/error: assert DB unchanged and evaluate with AccessDeniedMetric.
    
        Args:
            first_response: Initial assistant response to the update attempt
            prompt_used: The original non-admin update prompt
            original_value: The original DB value visible to Non Admin (for equality check)
            index: Attachment index label
            max_turns: Maximum number of turns to attempt (default 3)
        """
        turns = [
            {"role": "user", "content": prompt_used},
            {"role": "assistant", "content": first_response}
        ]
    
        current_prompt, current_response = prompt_used, first_response
    
        for turn in range(1, max_turns):
            reply = self.generate.reply_for_llm(
                current_response, self.section_name, self.entry_name, current_prompt, turns=turns, section_desc=self.section_desc, item_desc=self.item_desc
            )
            # Add user reply to turns as soon as it is generated
            turns.append({"role": "user", "content": reply})
            ask_result = self.client.ask(chat_id=self.chat_id, user_query=reply, user_type="Non Admin")
            next_response = ask_result["text_response"]
            next_metadata = ask_result.get("metadata")
            next_type = next_metadata.get("type") if next_metadata else None
            # Add assistant response to turns as soon as it is captured
            turns.append({"role": "assistant", "content": next_response})
    
            # Attach full turns before any validation/branching
            allure.attach(str(turns), name=f"Turns [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
    
            if next_metadata:
                allure.attach(str(next_metadata), name=f"Turn {turn+1} Metadata [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                # Validate section/entry mappings
                self.validate_metadata_match(next_metadata)
    
            if next_type == "success":
                # Non Admin should not succeed; restore via metadata.old and assert DB unchanged
                self.validate_metadata_and_restore_db(next_metadata, user_type="Admin")
                updated_value = self.client.get_config_entry(self.section_name, self.entry_name, user_type="Non Admin")
                if updated_value != original_value:
                    restore_success = self.client.update_config_entry_value(original_value, user_type="Admin")
                    allure.attach(str(restore_success), name=f"Restored DB to original [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                    updated_value = self.client.get_config_entry(self.section_name, self.entry_name, user_type="Non Admin")
                allure.attach(str(updated_value), name=f"Updated Config Value [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                assert updated_value == original_value, (
                    f"Non-admin user was able to update the DB value, which should not be allowed.\nPrompt: {prompt_used}\nDB Value: {updated_value}")
    
                # Evaluate denying behavior
                allure.attach(str(turns), name=f"Turns [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                metric = self.ragmetric("AccessDeniedMetric")
                test_case = LLMTestCase(input=prompt_used, actual_output=next_response)
                metric.measure(test_case)
                allure.attach(str(metric.score), name=f"Score [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(metric.reason), name=f"Reason [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                assert metric.is_successful(), f"Failed: {metric.reason}"
                return
            elif next_type == "error":
                # Expected denial for Non Admin edits: ensure DB unchanged and evaluate access denial
                updated_value = self.client.get_config_entry(self.section_name, self.entry_name, user_type="Non Admin")
                if updated_value != original_value:
                    restore_success = self.client.update_config_entry_value(original_value, user_type="Admin")
                    allure.attach(str(restore_success), name=f"Restored DB to original [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                    updated_value = self.client.get_config_entry(self.section_name, self.entry_name, user_type="Non Admin")
                allure.attach(str(updated_value), name=f"Updated Config Value [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                assert updated_value == original_value, (
                    f"Non-admin user was able to update the DB value, which should not be allowed.\nPrompt: {prompt_used}\nDB Value: {updated_value}")
    
                allure.attach(str(turns), name=f"Turns [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                metric = self.ragmetric("AccessDeniedMetric")
                test_case = LLMTestCase(input=current_prompt, actual_output=next_response)
                metric.measure(test_case)
                allure.attach(str(metric.score), name=f"Score [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                allure.attach(str(metric.reason), name=f"Reason [{index}]", attachment_type=allure.attachment_type.TEXT)
                assert metric.is_successful(), f"Failed: {metric.reason}"
                return
    
            current_prompt, current_response = reply, next_response
    
        # After max_turns, assert DB unchanged and evaluate last response
